description: Nexlink ISP domain-specific retrieval benchmark. Each question carries the categories an architecture is expected to excel at: basic (naive), citation (hybrid, exact identifiers), multihop (agentic, decomposition). A metadata_filter question demonstrates pre-search payload filtering.

questions.question: Which Nextlink internet plan costs the most per month, and what is its price?
What does a solid blue Wi-Fi LED indicate on the Nextlink-Optic-V1?
questions.notes: Hardware lookup from a spec sheet table.

questions.question: How much does a Nextlink technician dispatch cost the customer?
What is the first step a support agent should take when a customer reports a whole-home no-internet outage?
questions.notes: Procedural start of a troubleshooting guide.

questions.question: What is the healthy optical receive power range for the Nextlink-Optic-V1 ONT?
questions.notes: Range lookup; numbers embed indistinctly, partially lexical.

questions.question: What does error code ERR-4091 mean?
questions.notes: Exact identifier that does not embed distinctively.

questions.question: What is the fix for error code ERR-2210?
questions.notes: Exact identifier; remedy lives in the code catalog.

questions.question: Per Section 3.2 of the service credit policy, what happens to credits above $25.00?
questions.notes: Section citation; needs the exact section heading.

questions.question: Which hardware model logs ERR-7745, and which 5 GHz channel change fixes the dropouts?
questions.notes: Error code to model mapping plus a channel reference.

questions.question: What is the remedy for ERR-5513 before a technician dispatch is scheduled?
questions.notes: Code-first question with a multi-step remedy.

questions.question: A customer's Nextlink-Coax-V2 reports ERR-3321 after a thunderstorm and the modem still drops after two power cycles. What is the recommended next step and which policy governs it?
questions.notes: Combines a hardware remedy with a dispatch policy decision.

questions.question: A Nextlink-WiFi-V3 router near an airport keeps logging ERR-7745. What is the root cause and which configuration changes stop the dropouts?
questions.notes: Cause plus two config changes across two documents.

questions.question: An Optic-V1 customer has optical power at -28 dBm with ERR-5513 and a verified 6-hour outage. Does the outage qualify for a service credit and how is the credit computed?
questions.notes: Three hops: hardware fault + outage eligibility + computation.

questions.question: A support agent wants to apply a $150.00 credit for a 6-hour outage on an account without supervisor approval. Which policy threshold blocks the credit, and which error code applies if the account is also in arrears?
questions.notes: Policy threshold plus a secondary error code lookup.

questions.question: Restricting to the error code reference document, what does ERR-9910 mean?
